prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: five glass containers sliding into a row across the counter, lids off. The camera tracks a ladle filling them in sequence — rice, then colorful roasted vegetables, then shredded chicken — layers building fast and rhythmically. Money shot: the fifth container completed as a drizzle of green herb sauce zigzags across all five in one motion, macro on the glistening layers. Final beat: lids clicking on one by one, the row of ready meals glowing under warm light. Deep shadows, satisfying repetition, film grain. Dominant sound: the ladle hits, then the lid clicks. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
